title: Evaluation-normalized adjunction for the fixed native derived tensor
statement: Let C be a category with object universe c and morphism universe v, J a Grothendieck topology on C, and R a sheaf of commutative rings in universe max(c,v,u). Assume additive sheafification and that local equivalences agree with locally bijective maps at that universe, and choose any derived-category universe w with HasDerivedCategory. Use the category of R-module sheaves with sections in max(c,v,u), its unbounded derived category, the recorded derivedInternalHomOfUniverses [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], and the fixed native localization monoidal structure and simultaneous K-flat tensor comparison [lem-sf-ringed-derived-native-tensor]. Then the recorded derived internal Hom is right adjoint, in its second variable, to tensoring on the right by each derived object for that fixed monoidal structure. The adjunctions are natural in the tensor parameter. The fixed simultaneous K-flat comparison satisfies the componentwise uncurrying equation of [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. Equivalently there is a CoefficientClosedStructure whose monoidal structure is the native one, and CoefficientTensorModels whose comparison is the native simultaneous comparison. This result asserts no symmetry, no one-K-flat comparison, and no structural pure-section constraints.

source.place: Tag 08J9, using the total tensor-Hom calculation of 0A90 and global H0 calculation of 0A8Z.

proof.text: Use the explicit independent-universe module tensor-Hom adjunction and the signed isomorphism from the recorded sheaf Hom complex to the monoidal internal-Hom complex. Compose currying with the complex braiding. The two Koszul signs cancel on each homogeneous tensor summand. Prove naturality in all three variables and compute the underived sheafified pure-tensor evaluation. Reuse the existing moduleTmul_braiding generator theorem for the ordinary pure-tensor symmetry.

The adopted homotopy-category tensor-Hom adjunction induces exactly this chain-level equivalence on quotient maps. For K-flat L and the fixed K-injective replacement I(M), Hom(L,I(M)) is K-injective. Apply the bijection from homotopy classes into a K-injective complex to derived morphisms, on both sides. Compose with the fixed native tensor comparison and the fixed Hom representative isomorphism. Compute the resulting inverse currying on chain representatives, including the inverse localized augmentation.

Functorial flat resolutions show that the inclusion of the recorded K-flat complexes followed by Q is a localization. Prove naturality of the representative equivalence using surjectivity of maps to the K-injective Hom complex and naturality of the tensor comparison, Hom comparison, and inverse augmentation. Product localization and its fully faithful restriction functor descend this natural isomorphism of three-variable Hom functors to the derived category.

Package the descended natural Hom equivalences with Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv. Naturality in the tensor parameter gives evaluation_naturality by applying inverse currying to identity morphisms. Restrict the descended isomorphism back to K-flat representatives, use the chain-level pure-tensor formula, and obtain CoefficientTensorUncurryModel for the fixed native comparison. The monoidal structure equality and heterogeneous comparison equality are reflexive.

lean.statement:
theorem closedAdjunction :
    ∃ S : CoefficientClosedStructure (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, u, w} J R),
      S.monoidal = monoidal.{c, v, u, w} J R ∧
        ∃ T : CoefficientTensorModels.{u, c, v, w} J R S,
          HEq T.comparison (comparison.{c, v, u, w} J R)
lean.note: The adopted HomTensorTotal and KInjectiveHomComplex signatures restrict coefficients to max(site-object,site-morphism); SignedCalculus fixes the site universes together. None supplies this independent extra coefficient universe and arbitrary chosen derived-category universe verbatim. The generic derived closed structure is available, but identification with the recorded sheaf Hom complex and evaluation normalization still need the independent-universe argument recorded here.
